item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Selena Gomez and her mental health startup accused of fraud
item.description: Several investors in Selena Gomez’s mental health startup Wondermind sued the popstar Thursday, claiming they were misled about the startup’s success and her involvement in it.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US retail sales slump unexpectedly after a summer tax-refund boost fades
item.description: After splurging on the World Cup and Amazon Prime Day sales, Americans unexpectedly cut their spending in July by the biggest amount in more than a year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Paid tariffs on overseas purchases? Your refund may be on the way
item.description: Americans who paid tariffs on overseas purchases through shippers like FedEx and UPS could soon see refunds hit their accounts.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Average packed school lunch is now over $6: How to pack a healthy lunch for less
item.description: Remember when a school lunch used to cost $1.50? Not anymore, with many children's lunches now $7 per day. A nutrition expert shows ways to eat healthy for less.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Video shows aftermath of non-combat military crash; pilot walks away after ejecting
